questions.question_text:
The country of Zombieland is in distress since more than 75% of its working
population is suffering from serious health issues. Studies conducted by competent
health experts concluded that a complete lack of physical exercise among its
working population was one of the leading causes of their health issues. As one of
the measures to address the problem, the Government of Zombieland has decided
to provide monetary incentives to those who ride bicycles to work.

Based only on the information provided above, which one of the following
statements can be logically inferred with certainty?

options.A: All the working population of Zombieland will henceforth ride bicycles to work.
options.B:
Riding bicycles will ensure that all of the working population of Zombieland is free
of health issues.
options.C:
The health experts suggested to the Government of Zombieland to declare riding
bicycles as mandatory.
options.D:
The Government of Zombieland believes that riding bicycles is a form of physical
exercise.

questions.explaination: The passage establishes that a complete lack of physical exercise is a primary cause of health issues, and in response, the government provides financial incentives to ride bicycles to work. This direct causal measure logically implies that the government views bicycle riding as a form of physical exercise.

questions.explaination: Setting $f(t) = g(t) \implies 0.01 t^2 = 4t \implies t = 400$. For any $0 < t < 400$ (e.g., $t = 10$), $g(10) = 40 > f(10) = 1$, making statement (i) correct. For all $t > 400$, the quadratic growth of $f(t)$ strictly dominates the linear growth of $g(t)$, so choosing $T = 400$ satisfies statement (ii). Hence, both statements are correct.

questions.question_text:
Which one of the following sentence sequences creates a coherent narrative?
(i)
Once on the terrace, on her way to her small room in the corner, she
notices the man right away.
(ii)
She begins to pant by the time she has climbed all the stairs.
(iii)
Mina has bought vegetables and rice at the market, so her bags are
heavy.
(iv)
He was leaning against the parapet, watching the traffic below.
questions.explaination: Sentence (iii) introduces the protagonist Mina carrying heavy market purchases. Sentence (ii) describes the resulting exertion as she climbs the stairs. Sentence (i) brings her onto the terrace where she spots a man. Sentence (iv) details the man's posture against the parapet. Thus, the coherent sequence is (iii), (ii), (i), (iv).

questions.explaination: We are given $f(x) = g(y)$ for all independent real variables $x$ and $y$. If $x$ varies while $y$ remains constant, $f(x)$ cannot change because $g(y)$ is fixed, meaning $f(x)$ must be a constant. Symmetrically, $g(y)$ must be identical to that same constant. Therefore, $f(x) = g(y) = \text{constant}$.
